baseline_models.focus_anchor: The accusative مَّتَاعًا at word 1 is followed by two coordinated beneficiary phrases, لَكُمْ and وَلِأَنْعَامِكُمْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The usable-provision branch of م ت ع and the grazing-livestock branch of ن ع م make the clause an allocation formula: one field of usable goods is directed toward human and animal recipients. Repetition of the beneficiary lām gives the animals an explicit claim rather than treating them as incidental property.

activation_trace.role: Usable goods that meet needs supply the clause's concrete object of allocation.
Grazing livestock supplies the second literal beneficiary class and makes the allocation ecological rather than human-only.

changed_reading.before: The clause merely labels an unspecified bounty as provision.
changed_reading.after: The clause distributes usable provision across two expressly named classes, humans and their grazing animals.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَّتَاعًا names benefit or enjoyment, while أَنْعَامِكُمْ is literally livestock but remains inside the wider ن ع م word-field.
baseline_models.mechanism: Benefit enjoyed and used meets the same root-field that contains both livestock and bestowed well-being. The animal reading remains literal, yet the juxtaposition lets the herd function simultaneously as recipient of benefit and as a material embodiment of favorable living conditions.

activation_trace.role: Enjoyed and usable benefit makes the provision a lived good, not only an inventory item.
The livestock branch fixes the syntactic referent and prevents the favor overtone from replacing the animals.
Pleasant well-being and bestowed favor add a latent evaluative resonance to the literal livestock term.

changed_reading.before: Humans receive provision and livestock are an appended practical concern.
changed_reading.after: Well-being is distributed through a human-herd system in which livestock both receive provision and visibly instantiate bestowed flourishing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَّتَاعًا can activate an extended keeping-for-benefit branch, and the repeated lām names those kept in benefit: you and your livestock.
baseline_models.mechanism: Instead of treating provision as a momentary meal, the prolonged-keeping branch frames it as maintenance that lets human and animal life continue through an interval. This is form-distant from the ordinary noun sense, so it supplements rather than replaces usable provision.

activation_trace.role: Prolonged preservation for continued benefit supplies the temporal function assigned to the provision.
The herd makes maintenance intergenerational and ecological rather than an isolated human act of consumption.

changed_reading.before: Provision is a consumable object available now.
changed_reading.after: Provision is also a maintenance interval that keeps a coupled human-animal livelihood going.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening contrast misdirected attention toward one who presents himself as self-sufficient and away from one who comes striving for benefit. Against that social economy, 80:32's repeated beneficiary lām places humans beside livestock as receivers. Provision therefore undercuts the posture of independence: usefulness is received according to need, not secured by rank.

activation_trace.role: Benefit enjoyed and used anchors the changed reading in the focus clause's own utility term.
Literal livestock become co-recipients whose dependence exposes human dependence by coordination.
Turning away supplies the opening act of withholding attention from a needy recipient.
Benefit opposed to harm makes usefulness, rather than prestige, the explicit criterion at stake.
Claimed self-sufficiency supplies the social posture that the later recipient syntax destabilizes.
Purposeful movement toward a sought good identifies the overlooked person as an active seeker of benefit.

structural_cues: The opening alternates between a self-sufficient addressee and a seeker who arrives striving; 80:32 later coordinates human and animal beneficiaries with repeated lām.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies turning away, benefit, self-sufficiency, striving, and the focus coordination; I infer that the later dependency relation answers the earlier status error. A live alternative is that 80:32 only allocates produce and carries no social correction backward.

changed_reading.before: The shared provision model simply broadens the list of recipients.
changed_reading.after: The human-animal pairing also levels pretensions of self-sufficiency: every beneficiary is a dependent receiver, so need outranks status.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier reminder can benefit a receptive seeker; later food is livelihood, and 80:32 names its enjoyed utility. The focus provision becomes a second register of benefit: bodily and ecological sustenance stands beside mnemonic-moral benefit without collapsing into it.

activation_trace.role: Enjoyed utility anchors the material member of the paired benefit pattern.
A reminder that causes recollection supplies the nonmaterial vehicle whose benefit is stated in the same ayah.
Benefit opposed to harm provides the functional term connecting reminder and provision.
Food as livelihood and good condition fixes the later benefit in bodily subsistence.

structural_cues: The reminder-benefit pair occurs before the command to inspect food, while 80:32 closes the food sequence by naming its utility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two explicit utility-bearing complexes, reminder-benefit and food-provision; I infer a deliberate two-register pattern. They may instead be independent examples with no intended correspondence.

changed_reading.before: مَّتَاعًا denotes only the practical use of the listed produce.
changed_reading.after: Material provision is one mode in a wider economy of benefit, paired with but distinct from a reminder that nourishes recollection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ordered operations direct sight to food, deliver poured water, open fertile earth, and bring vegetation out. مَّتَاعًا is therefore not merely a stock of goods; it is the terminal function of a conversion process in which water and earth become usable life-support.

activation_trace.role: Usable provision names the output and purpose of the preceding transformations.
Directed sight turns the production chain into something the human recipient must inspect.
Food as livelihood states the process's human-facing function before the focus generalizes its beneficiaries.
Pouring supplies the first directed material operation.
Delivery of water specifies the transferred material that enables the next stages.
Opening by fissure supplies the transformation that makes emergence from the ground possible.
Soft fertile earth is the receptive medium rather than a passive backdrop.
Vegetation emerging from earth supplies the converted living output.

structural_cues: Ayat 25-27 form an ordered pour, split, and bring-forth sequence before the itemized yields and the purpose-like accusative مَّتَاعًا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successive material operations and a final utility noun; I supply the causal arrow that reads the noun as the chain's terminal function. The sequence can alternatively be read as a display of acts rather than a process model.

changed_reading.before: Provision is a static collection of edible things.
changed_reading.after: Provision is water-earth-growth throughput whose endpoint is usable support for human and animal life.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 80:22 the ن ش ر inventory holds both raising the dead and rain reviving dried pasture. The subsequent water, vegetation, and pasture sequence realizes that cross-domain image materially. By 80:32, provision is life transmitted from a revived earth into humans and herds.

activation_trace.role: Usable provision is the focus-level form taken by the earth's renewed yield.
Grazing livestock make revived pasture part of the focus clause's actual recipient system.
Reviving a dead person supplies the explicit life-after-death pole of the analogy.
Rain reviving dried pasture furnishes the lexical bridge from human revival to the food ecology.
Conveyed water supplies the revivifying medium later in the sequence.
Plant emergence makes renewed life visible as food-bearing matter.
Pasture completes the branch bridge and directs revived vegetation toward the livestock named in the focus.

structural_cues: Human revival at 80:22 precedes water, opened earth, plant emergence, pasture, and finally provision for humans and livestock.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies both resurrection and rain-revived pasture under one branch inventory, plus the later water-growth sequence; I infer a structural analogy and a flow of renewed life into eaters. The live alternative keeps eschatological revival and ordinary agriculture separate.

changed_reading.before: The produce is a created stock available for consumption.
changed_reading.after: The provision is the consumable phase of revivification: dead-looking earth returns as plant life and sustains humans and grazing animals.

context_deltas.mechanism: Moist herbage, oil as food provision, enclosed dense gardens, pleasant fruit, and pasture are materially unlike outputs. The focus pairing does not flatten them into generic bounty; it closes a differentiated ecology whose yields can serve human and animal bodies in overlapping but nonidentical ways.

activation_trace.role: Usable goods unify unlike outputs by function without erasing their material differences.
The grazing-herd recipient makes fodder and pasture indispensable parts of the allocation.
Fresh moist herbage supplies a soft vegetative yield distinct from grain and tree fruit.
Oil as food, provision, and gift adds a processed and storable human-facing use.
Enclosed gardens supply an organized productive habitat rather than a loose list of plants.
Thick interwoven growth gives that habitat density and productive mass.
Pleasant fruit supplies an immediately human-readable yield at the list's close.
Pasture places a herd-facing yield beside fruit immediately before the dual-beneficiary clause.

structural_cues: Fruit and pasture form the final coordinated pair before مَّتَاعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَامِكُمْ, while the larger list moves through field crops, tree crops, and gardens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies differentiated yields and two beneficiary classes; I infer functional allocation across an ecology. I do not infer a rigid fruit-for-humans and pasture-for-animals partition, because overlap remains materially possible.

changed_reading.before: All listed growth collapses into an undifferentiated bounty for two recipients.
changed_reading.after: The focus names the common use of a diversified production ecology, with human food and herd forage adjacent yet not exhaustively partitioned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The charge of covering a favor and the failure to discharge what was commanded activate the favor branch latent beside the literal livestock sense of أَنْعَامِكُمْ. The animals remain actual eaters, but their name becomes a hinge: they receive the bounty straightforwardly while the human recipient is capable of masking its status as bestowed good.

activation_trace.role: Grazing livestock fixes the direct referent and the nonhuman side of the recipient pair.
Bestowed favorable living activates an overtone of gift within the livestock root-field.
Covering a blessing supplies the precise moral failure that turns the favor overtone into a live contrast.
Discharging what is due gives the uncompleted command the shape of an owed response.
Binding request supplies the demand to which the provisioned human has not yet adequately answered.

structural_cues: The ingratitude accusation and unfulfilled command precede the invitation to inspect food and its allocation to humans and livestock.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a literal livestock branch, a same-root favor branch, explicit concealment of favor, and an unfulfilled demand; I infer a morally charged lexical hinge. The live alternative is to hear only the ordinary livestock noun with no favor resonance.

changed_reading.before: أَنْعَامِكُمْ simply adds the animals that eat part of the produce.
changed_reading.after: The livestock term remains literal but also exposes provision as favor, sharpening the contrast between animal reception and human capacity to conceal the gift.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus can describe prolonged maintenance of a shared livelihood, but the post-focus scene abruptly separates a person from brother and companion, while each person's own affair suffices to occupy him. Provision maintains relations in ordinary time; it does not make their mutual availability absolute.

activation_trace.role: Extended keeping for benefit supplies the maintenance model that the later rupture limits.
Each person's affair being sufficient to occupy him blocks transfer of ordinary mutual support.
Flight supplies the active severing of the relations within which provision normally circulates.
Brotherhood and kinship identify one ordinary support bond that fails under the event.
Close companionship supplies another sustained bond from which the person flees.

structural_cues: The branchless ص خ خ cue at 80:33 marks the abrupt boundary immediately after provision; 80:34-36 then enumerate ruptured family relations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies extended benefit, an uncited but structurally marked rupture, flight from kin, and individual preoccupation; I infer that the maintenance horizon is temporary. The later scene may limit relationships without semantically limiting مَّتَاعًا itself.

changed_reading.before: Provision appears to secure the continuing human-herd livelihood without an expressed horizon.
changed_reading.after: Provision maintains shared life only within a bounded interval; the next event reveals that neither goods nor care relations guarantee enduring mutual availability.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the ن ع م branch about an ostrich's departure and a group's dispersal behind a focus form that ordinarily means livestock. It remains anchored in أَنْعَامِكُمْ and gains a visible mechanism from the later flight from kin, but downstream prose should present it only as a remote word-field echo, never as the translation of أَنْعَام.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The literal livestock noun أَنْعَامِكُمْ shares its root inventory with an idiom of departing ostriches and a scattered group.

activation_trace.role: Departure of the ostrich and dispersal of a group supply a remote motion image latent behind the focus root.
Literal flight later realizes the dispersal pattern at the human-family level.
Kinship supplies the group relation whose members disperse from one another.

changed_reading.before: Livestock are stable co-recipients within the provisioned household ecology.
changed_reading.after: At the far edge of the root-field, the livestock term casts a faint anticipatory shadow of the human group scattering immediately after the focus.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the excellence, increase, or strength image belongs to broader م ت ع usage rather than the plain noun's minimum sense. It remains anchored in مَّتَاعًا and is materially activated by thick interwoven gardens; render it as a possible surplus resonance, not a claim that the verse lexically says abundance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَّتَاعًا can activate the branch of reaching excellence, increase, or strength rather than only bare usefulness.

activation_trace.role: Excellence, increase, and strength recast provision as robust sufficiency or surplus.
Thick, strongly interwoven growth gives the surplus reading a visible ecological substrate.

changed_reading.before: The yield is a ration adequate to immediate need.
changed_reading.after: The dense gardens allow مَّتَاعًا to suggest resilient productive capacity exceeding a single meal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it treats usable goods as evidence and joins the command to look with a later image of uncovering and illumination. It stays anchored in the inspectable provision named by مَّتَاعًا, but downstream prose should mark the disclosure function as a compositional inference rather than a dictionary sense of the noun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The usable goods named by مَّتَاعًا are the visible endpoint of the food sequence that the human is commanded to inspect.

activation_trace.role: Concrete usable goods provide the inspectable evidence at the focus.
Directing sight or insight makes the food process an object of evidentiary attention.
Removal of a covering supplies the later disclosure image that sharpens what looking can accomplish.
Light appearing in a face gives disclosure a visible positive outcome without making it automatic for every observer.

changed_reading.after: Provision can also disclose its own production chain to attentive sight, functioning as material evidence as well as food.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the most form-distant م ت ع activation: going off with a thing or dispensing with someone is not the ordinary sense of مَّتَاعًا here. The focus root and the later flight make a coherent impermanence mechanism, but it should appear only as an ironic echo that unsettles possession, never as a replacement gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun مَّتَاعًا shares its inventory with an idiom of going away with a thing or dispensing with someone.

activation_trace.role: Going off with a thing or dispensing with someone supplies an unstable counterimage to secure possession.
Flight turns the latent going-away image into the next scene's governing motion.
Each person's own affair being sufficient removes the ordinary availability of others and their goods.

changed_reading.before: The beneficiaries possess a stable stock designated for them.
changed_reading.after: A remote idiomatic echo makes the stock look like temporary usufruct: goods and companions can be gone from one's reach when the next event arrives.

strongest_changes: The focus shifts from a static bounty label to the terminal function of a water-earth-growth conversion process.
The repeated beneficiary lām makes livestock co-recipients and exposes human self-sufficiency as a posture rather than a fact.
The paired branches of human resurrection and rain-revived pasture make provision the consumable phase of renewed life.
The literal livestock term can simultaneously carry a restrained favor resonance, sharpened by the prior charge of concealing blessing.
summary.what_was_special: The compact clause behaves as a hinge. It closes a diversified production ecology, answers an earlier dispute about who receives benefit, holds livestock and favor in one root-field, and then yields abruptly to a scene that limits ordinary maintenance and possession. These mechanisms coexist rather than resolving into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The favor resonance in أَنْعَامِكُمْ is lexically available but may be inaudible beside the dominant livestock noun.
The fruit-pasture adjacency supports differentiated allocation, but it does not prove an exclusive human-versus-animal partition.
The resurrection-pasture bridge is unusually direct at the branch level, while the claim that it organizes the ayah sequence remains abductive.
The dispersal, surplus, disclosure, and carried-off readings are deliberately retained as qualified outliers because their branches are form-distant.
